scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid a parking-unload problem during the Monday evening timing-clinic gear transport.
Emerging Need: A stored practice-log note makes the changing dock-access notices relevant because the long shared paddles require car delivery and nearby legal unloading.
Decision Context: Early updates leave garage access unavailable; once the organizer opens a no-fee list, the reply window is brief and requires matching the carried item.
Consequence: If coordination waits until after the list is submitted, the clinic is still ahead but the car may lack legal unload access near the dock.

parameter.title: Rainwake timing-paddle clinic
parameter.description: Evening Lake Union practice focused on timing calls and starts.

parameter.subject: Preliminary Monday curb-work notice near Westlake dock
parameter.body: Crews are reviewing repainting work along the north curb for Monday afternoon and evening. Some short-term unload spaces may be unavailable, but the marina has not yet assigned alternate garage access. Please wait for Sunday confirmation before sending access-code requests.

parameter.content: Sara says nobody should ask for Monday garage codes yet. She is matching any access to the gear-haul list after the marina confirms spaces tomorrow, and random early requests will just be ignored.

parameter.subject: Monday Westlake garage code window for approved gear haulers
parameter.body: The marina confirmed the dock curb will be no-stopping from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM Monday. I can put people who are already carrying shared club items on the free evening garage list if I receive their name and carried item by 4:30 PM today. No plate numbers needed. The list is sent once to the garage desk.

parameter.content: Sara just submitted the Monday garage list to the marina desk. They told her they won't accept late additions, and the no-stopping signs are scheduled to go up before evening practice.
